title: Book 8 — Urania, Chapter 48
paragraphs: All the rest who served in the fleet furnished triremes, but the Melians, Siphnians, and Seriphians furnished fifty-oared galleys: the Melians, who are of Lacedaemonian descent, furnished two; the Siphnians and Seriphians, who are Ionians from Athens, one each. The total number of ships, apart from the fifty-oared galleys, was 378.
